phone.scope: Compiled game with real touch events in software WebGL; not a physical-phone FPS benchmark.

notes: Floors snap to wall/doorway tops at matching 2m cells.
Optional piece elevation persists in existing version-1 saves; legacy piece IDs and wood retained.
Height-aware movement and ceiling collision prevent teleportation through upper floors.
Story-aware support, occupancy, door interaction and dismantling preserve structural dependencies.
Tests use compiled production assets and actual mouse/keyboard/touch input; no writable game hooks.
